exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: attendance.manual_building_circles: manually defined circular building boundaries; inside when distance to center is less than radius

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite circle radius and one already-derived finite center-to-coordinate distance expressed in the same source-aligned unit.
outputBoundary: Classify the coordinate as inside only when distance is strictly less than radius; equality and greater distance are not inside.
limitations: The radius is synthetic fixture configuration; the source does not disclose the manually selected centers or building-specific radii needed by the full profile.
This binding does not derive a distance from latitude and longitude or choose a distance formula or unit.
This binding does not detect a temporal boundary crossing, arrival, or departure from successive coordinates.
This binding does not implement the source GPS-missing and reappearance inference.
This binding does not implement Wi-Fi fingerprint matching or its fallback relationship with GPS.
This binding does not join a building classification to classroom schedules or infer attendance.
A missing or non-finite radius or distance fails closed.
